title: The Waiting Heart
content:
The morning sun gently spread its golden light across the hills of Shimla.

A fresh breeze drifted through the windows of Yashwanth's house.

Yashwanth woke up with a smile.

Only one week remained until his wedding.

The thought alone filled his heart with excitement.

After getting ready, he walked toward Siddu's room.

The door was slightly open.

As he peeked inside...

He found Siddu sitting before his laptop, attending an online meeting.

Several documents were spread across the table.

His phone continued ringing with work-related calls, yet he patiently handled each one.

Yashwanth quietly stood at the doorway.

"He's been here for nearly two and a half weeks..."

"He left everything behind in France..."

"And he'll stay another week just for my wedding."

A feeling of gratitude filled his heart.

Just then...

A familiar voice came from behind.

"What happened, Yashwanth?"

He turned around.

Standing there...

Was Siddu's father.

Yashwanth smiled faintly.

"I was just thinking..."

"Your son has been struggling so much because of me."

Siddu's father smiled warmly.

"Struggling?"

He gently shook his head.

"He never thinks of it that way."

"When the people he loves are happy..."

"That's enough for him."

Yashwanth smiled.

Those words perfectly described Siddu.

A few minutes later...

The online meeting came to an end.

Siddu stepped out of his room with a tired smile.

"Good morning."

"Good morning," Yashwanth replied.

As they walked downstairs together, Siddu suddenly said,

"Today, Shreya, Sneha, and Yagnesh are arriving."

"I invited them for your wedding."

Yashwanth smiled knowingly.

"Then don't waste any more time."

"Go and receive your loved one."

Siddu immediately turned toward him.

"My... what?"

Yashwanth chuckled.

"I didn't say anything."

"Just go before they're kept waiting."

Siddu narrowed his eyes suspiciously before smiling.

"Fine."

"I'll see you later."

Without wasting another moment...

He picked up his car keys and drove toward the airport.

________________________________________

The airport was bustling with travellers.

Siddu glanced at the arrival board.

The flight from Paris had landed just a few minutes earlier.

Without realizing it...

His heartbeat began to quicken.

"Why am I so nervous?"

"I've met thousands of people..."

"Then why does meeting one person make my heart race like this?"

He let out a quiet laugh at himself.

It wasn't fear.

It wasn't anxiety.

It was the excitement of meeting someone his heart had never truly forgotten.

He smiled to himself and began searching through the crowd.

Families reunited with warm embraces.

Children ran into their parents' arms.

Travelers hurried toward the exit.

Siddu carefully scanned every face.

Finally...

He spotted Shreya.

Standing beside her...

Was Yagnesh.

Siddu immediately walked toward them.

"Hello."

Shreya's face lit up.

"Siddu!"

"How are you?"

He smiled warmly.

"I'm doing well."

His eyes shifted toward the young man beside her.

"You must be Yagnesh."

Yagnesh smiled and extended his hand.

"Yes."

"It's nice to finally meet you."

Siddu shook his hand.

"The pleasure is mine."

Even while speaking...

His eyes continued searching the crowd.

Shreya quietly noticed.

A small smile appeared on her face.

"Looking for someone?"

Siddu hesitated for a moment.

Before he could answer...

Shreya softly said,

"Sneha had something important to take care of."

"So she left before we came out."

For a brief moment...

The smile on Siddu's face faded.

A quiet disappointment settled inside his heart.

He had waited five years to see her.

And somehow...

He had missed her by only a few moments.

Still...

He forced a gentle smile.

"I see."

"Let's go."

He picked up their luggage and led them toward the car.

As they walked out of the airport...

Siddu couldn't help but glance back one last time.

Somewhere beyond those departing crowds...

The woman he had waited five long years to see...

Had already walked away.

Only a few moments...

Only a few steps...

Had separated them.

But fate...

Wasn't ready for their reunion just yet.
